title: Photosynthesis Lab: Energy Flow in a Leaf
description: High-school biology investigation into how plants convert light energy into chemical energy and how that energy moves through an ecosystem. Students design an experiment, collect data on oxygen production at different light intensities, and connect their findings to the broader carbon cycle and the role of plants as producers in food webs.

sections.title: Setup and Background
sections.description: Students review the chemistry of photosynthesis and prepare lab materials.

objectives.title: Watch Me
objectives.description: Watch the introductory video on photosynthesis and cellular respiration.

objectives.title: Equation Review
objectives.description: Write out the balanced chemical equation for photosynthesis: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 + 6 O2. Identify reactants and products.

sections.title: Experimental Design
sections.description: Design and run an investigation to measure how light intensity affects oxygen production by aquatic plants.

objectives.title: Hypothesis
objectives.description: Develop a testable hypothesis predicting how oxygen production rate changes with light intensity. Justify your prediction using the photosynthesis reaction.

objectives.title: Variables
objectives.description: Identify the independent variable, dependent variable, and at least three controlled variables for the experiment. Explain why each control matters.

objectives.title: Procedure and Data Collection
objectives.description: Plan and conduct an investigation that measures oxygen bubble production from Elodea sprigs at five different light intensities. Record data in a structured table with units.

sections.title: Energy Flow and Ecosystems
sections.description: Connect cellular-level photosynthesis to ecosystem-level energy and matter flow.

objectives.title: Producer Role
objectives.description: Explain how plants act as producers in a food web. Trace the path of carbon and energy from sunlight through a producer, to a primary consumer, to a secondary consumer.

objectives.title: Carbon Cycle Diagram
objectives.description: Construct a diagram of the carbon cycle showing how photosynthesis, cellular respiration, decomposition, and combustion move carbon between the atmosphere, biosphere, hydrosphere, and geosphere.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.description: Reflect on the investigation and what it taught you about energy flow.

objectives.title: Lab Reflection
objectives.description: Write a 100+ word reflection on what surprised you about the lab results, what sources of error you noticed, and how you would refine the experiment if you ran it again.
